bio: Few restaurants enjoy such an exceptional location as The Folly. Nestled on the banks of the River Thames, The Folly is a charming restaurant offering indulgent Afternoon Teas with unrivalled riverside view.  Afternoon Tea can be served either in the romantic main restaurant area, the outdoor floating riverside terrace, or if you would like a private dining experience, Afternoon Tea can be served in cosy outdoor dining domes.  Guests will be treated to a traditional Afternoon Tea including sandwiches with reinvented classic fillings, such as chicken with tarragon mayonnaise. This is followed by a selection of homemade scones with clotted cream and jam and an array of delectable cakes. Afternoon Tea is accompanied by a pot of tea or coffee and if guests would like to upgrade to a High Tea they will also be treated to a glass of Prosecco.  Located in the heart of of Oxford, The Folly restaurant is found along the Folly Bridge, Oxford City Centre.
